div.head: II As 25.2
div.ab: Se ðe of ðis gerednysse gá, gylde æt frumcyrre V punde, æt oþrum cyrre his wer, æt ðriddan ðolige ealle ðæs ðe he age ⁊ ura ealra freondscipes.
Se ðe of ðissa gerædnesse gá, gilde æt frumcirre V pund, æt oþrum cirre his wer, æt þriddan cirre ðolige ealles þæs (þe) he age ⁊ ure ealra freondscipes.
Qui ex hac institutione recesserit, emendet prima uice quinque libras, alia uice weram suam, ad terciam uicem perdat quicquid habebit et omnium nostrum amicitiam.
Se ðe of ðissa gerædnesse gá, gilde æt frumcirre V pund, æt oþrum cirre his wer, æt þriddan cirre þolige ealles þæs he age ⁊ ure ealra freondscipes.
He who violates these ordinances shall, on the first occasion, pay 5 pounds; on the second occasion, his wergeld; and on the third he shall lose all that he has, and the friendship of us all.

He who deviates from this ordinance is to pay on the first occasion five pounds, on the second occasion his wergild, on the third occasion he is to forfeit all that he owns and the friendship of us all.
Wer von dieser Verordnung abweicht, zahle beim ersten Male 5 Pfund, beim zweiten Male sein Wergeld, beim dritten Male verliere er alles, was er besitzt und unser aller Freundschaft.
Whoever departs from this ordinance, let him pay 5 pounds the first time, his wergild the second time; the third time let him lose everything that he owns and the friendship of all of us.
